change.registered: complete optimized backend map, packed XYZI float32, 16 bytes/point, about 1 Hz
change.odom: frontend current pose composed with latest backend correction

wall_comparison.metric: p95-p5 horizontal projection on fixed normal, metres
wall_comparison.limitation: Includes physical surface shape/noise; no ground truth, splitting remains.

other_walk.limitation: User finished approximately nearby; endpoint distance is not return error. Replay on laptop at 2x.

wifi_payload_test.method: Existing sensor-only relay; temporary diagnostic publisher on Jetson emits 15 copies of recorded full map at 1 Hz. Laptop observes serialized payload and CRC. Backend not concurrently running. Diagnostic files removed from Jetson.
wifi_payload_test.limitation: Short map-only transport test. CDR bandwidth excludes protocol overhead. Cross-host header ages include clock offset and are NOT true end-to-end latency.

jetson_live.limitation: Static small map only. Live laptop diagnostic observer had incorrect DDS environment and received no topics; excluded from rate/loss assessment. RViz reception verified visually; source rates from relay log.

limitations: No new walk on final Jetson build yet.
Double surfaces and static drift remain; trajectory accuracy not established.
Full map bandwidth/memory grow with mapped area; no long-session stress validation.
2x replay observer received 2492 odometry messages vs 3063 saved poses; no no-drop claim for this observer.
Final snapshot delivery was verified in local replay; shutdown-time Wi-Fi delivery is not guaranteed.
Backend correction may move the displayed pose; no feedback into frontend estimator.
